dog.description_text:
Bella by name, Bella by nature! This sweet, lovable girl is full of charm, with a face that's pretty hard to resist!

Bella enjoys getting out and exploring the neighborhood, checking out all the interesting sights and smells along the way. She's also a big fan of other dogs and loves having a four-legged friend join her for a stroll!

She does well on a leash and is always happy to head out for a little adventure. Bella has already made great progress with her house-training and is becoming more familiar with her crate routine. She's a little cuddle bug who appreciates the simple things in life, especially a comfortable place to rest her head and someone nearby to keep her company. With those soulful eyes and that sweet little face, she has a way of making even the simplest moments feel special.

Registered adopters interested in Bella can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more information. Not approved yet? Apply today at hbrdogs.com!
